about.title: About
about.body1: Full-stack developer in career transition, currently completing the DWWM certification (level 5). I build applications that are useful in everyday life, from database to deployment: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind, Supabase.
about.body2: My background in data analysis (SQL, Python) brings me rigor and logic.
about.body3: Highlights: a childcare platform, a reading-tracker app, and the website for the Les Éclaireurs association.

timoun.desc: Platform connecting parents with childcare professionals: search, profiles, booking and messaging, with secure authentication.

noread.desc: Installable reading-tracker app (PWA): personal library, progress and statistics, synced in real time.

trivy.desc: Travel assistant that helps you pack your suitcase: smart lists based on destination, trip length and weather. Built as a team during a hackathon in my training.

eclaireurs.desc: Website for the Les Éclaireurs association, developed during my internship. Not deployed yet: demo coming soon.
